description: Aggregation presets (docs/06 B.5, C.2). A group is the elements sharing the group_by key; groups with more than threshold_per_cell members fold into aggregate elements of at most max_members each. group_by keys: storey, cell (anchor cell), zone, kit_or_class, system. max_cells (0 = all) keeps an even sample of the member cells on the aggregate to bound task size.

industrial_dense.description: Pipe racks and piping with hundreds of members per cell

healthcare_mep.description: Hospital models: fold per zone and class/system (ceiling-void MEP, partitions, fixtures)

civil_linear.description: Pavement layers, kerbs and barriers along chainage

hospital_dense.description: Legacy name: ceiling-void MEP per cell
